home.moment: Mid-combo on the Big Emoji: combo meter at ×3, numbers flying, a magical effect emoji on screen
setup: Start from a save with a big counter (Cheats › +1 Qa, or play)
Cheats › +10k combo taps, then Cheats › Spawn an effect emoji
Tap the Big Emoji fast and keep tapping while the burst is taken

shop.moment: Shop › Buildings, late game: five buildings with fun icons, several yellow (affordable) buy buttons
setup: Cheats › +1 Oc emojis, then buy into the later buildings (space station, candy kingdom, volcano...)
Scroll so five full cards show, ideally late ones, and pick a ×10 or Max buy amount

upgrades.moment: Shop › Upgrades with a funny employee quote open (the Farmers card works well)
setup: Open Upgrades, choose a building filter, tap an upgrade with a good quote
Make sure its buy button is yellow (affordable)

emojidex.moment: Emojidex › Collection, about half found, shiny emojis visible in the grid
setup: Cheats › +25 collection a few times, then +5 shiny
Pick the Faces category so the grid is full of familiar faces

slides._pops: Fallbacks for the numbers popping out of the screen; each capture folder's tune.json sets the ones its captures show
